description: Fetch recent application log lines. Scalingo returns an authenticated logs_url (GET /v1/apps/{app}/logs → { logs_url }); this tool then downloads the last N lines from it (dump mode) and returns them as text. Returns { logs_url, lines }. If the follow-up download fails, only logs_url is returned so you can fetch it yourself.

app.description: The app name (e.g. my-production-app) or app id (app-…).

lines.description: Number of recent log lines to fetch (1-1000, default 100).

name: get_app_logs
title: Get recent app logs
